narrative.overview: Eight original moonlit garden scenes, reflection-led hero, responsive living atlas, meaningful bounded motion. Seed aeb20778 retained.
keyCharacteristics: Actual original art is the dominant scene, not a card decoration.
Local Cyrillic-capable display and body type.
All content is readable without motion or JavaScript.
A single persistent accessible motion control.
dos: Retain original artwork provenance and bilingual parity.
Keep the custom shader bounded, low-power and optional.
donts: Do not invent medical, commercial or credential claims.
Do not infer a human approval receipt from a delegated decision.
Do not weaken CSP for third-party runtime scripts.
